text.tspan: Read the error first: it names the broken step
Step
You see
It means
1 · DNS
curl: (6) Could not resolve host: X
wget: bad address 'X' · NXDOMAIN
The name didn't turn into an IP
2 · Route
connect: Network is unreachable (instant)
YOUR own host has no route to that network
From <router> … Destination Net Unreachable
A router on the way has no route
From <your IP> … Destination Host Unreachable
No route to host
ARP for the next hop failed: gateway or local host
isn't answering (or ICMP host-unreachable came back)
Small requests work, big ones hang
Path MTU black hole (3.7)
3 · Port
(or 2)
curl: (28) … Timeout was reached
nc: … Operation timed out
Dropped silently: SG, NACL, firewall, NetworkPolicy,
wrong route, no return route, or the host is down
4 · Listener
curl: (7) Failed to connect … Couldn't connect to server
nc: … Connection refused
Reached the machine, but nothing listens on that port
(it answered with a TCP reset), or a firewall REJECTs
curl: (56) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer
Accepted, then reset. Tested: app on 127.0.0.1 behind
a port forward. Also: app crashed, TLS/HTTP mismatch
6 · App
curl: (60) SSL certificate problem …
Network fine: certificate untrusted, wrong name or
expired (3.6)
Network fine: the proxy or LB got a bad reply / has
no healthy backend / waited too long
Docker
Bind for 0.0.0.0:8081 failed: port is already allocated
Another container already uses that HOST port
Refused = you reached the host and it said no. Timeout = no answer at all: something dropped the packets.
curl 8.x prints (7) … Couldn't connect to server instead of "Connection refused"; nc still says refused.
